name: Ezreal
title: the Prodigal Explorer

Q.name: Mystic Shot
Q.description: Ezreal fires a bolt of energy, dealing 20/45/70/95/120 + 1.3×AD + 0.4×AP physical damage to the first enemy hit and reducing his Ability Cooldowns by 1.5 seconds.
Q.summary: Ezreal fires a damaging bolt of energy which reduces all of his cooldowns slightly if it strikes an enemy unit.

W.name: Essence Flux
W.description: Ezreal fires a magical orb that sticks to the first champion, structure, or epic jungle monster hit for 4 seconds. If Ezreal hits that target with an Attack or Ability, it detonates, dealing 80/135/190/245/300 + 1.15×bonus AD + 1×AP magic damage. Detonating with an Ability refunds the Mana cost of that Ability plus 60 Mana.
W.summary: Ezreal fires an orb that sticks to the first champion or objective hit. If Ezreal hits an enemy with the orb, it detonates and deals damage.

E.name: Arcane Shift
E.description: Ezreal teleports then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy, dealing 80/130/180/230/280 + 0.6×bonus AD + 0.75×AP magic damage. The bolt prioritizes enemies affected by Essence Flux.
E.summary: Ezreal teleports to a target nearby location and fires a homing bolt which strikes the nearest enemy unit. Prioritizes enemies stuck with Essence Flux.

R.name: Trueshot Barrage
R.description: Ezreal fires a massive energy arc that deals 350/600/850 + 1.1×bonus AD + 1.2×AP magic damage. Damage to minions and non-epic jungle monsters is reduced to 150/225/300 + 1×bonus AD + 1.1×AP magic damage.
R.summary: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).

Passive.name: Rising Spell Force
Passive.description: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.
Passive.summary: Ezreal gains increasing Attack Speed each time he successfully hits a spell, stacking up to 5 times.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Ezreal is a skillshot ADC who pokes with Mystic Shot and blinks with Arcane Shift. He plays bot lane, deals safe long-range damage and scales into a strong mid game.
strengths: Arcane Shift is a blink that makes him very safe.
Mystic Shot lowers his cooldowns, letting him spam abilities.
Long range poke from Q, W and R.
Strong mid game with Trinity Force and Muramana.
Trueshot Barrage is a global ultimate that finishes fights or clears waves.
weaknesses: Weak early: low base damage before items.
Lower damage than most ADCs late.
His W mark must be detonated by another ability or attack.

curve.lvl1: okay – Q poke but weak in all-ins
curve.lvl2: okay – W mark for more poke
curve.lvl3: good – E blink for safety and trades
curve.lvl6: good – Trueshot Barrage gives global damage
curve.items: strong – first item: Trinity Force or Muramana gives his main power spike; Iceborn Gauntlet or Serylda's Grudge for slowing
curve.late: okay – stays safe, but deals less damage than other ADCs

profile.curveNote: Ezreal wants all three basic abilities to poke safely, and his real power comes after Trinity Force and Muramana.
profile.waveClear: Good: Q and R clear waves.

keyAbilities.engage: W (Essence Flux) mark, detonated by Q
keyAbilities.answers: None. Ezreal has no spell shield or dodge; he relies on his blink.

Passive.notes: Rising Spell Force: gains attack speed when he hits abilities.

Q.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block. It is an ability, not an attack, so Jax E does not dodge it.
Q.notes: Mystic Shot: a missile that deals attack damage and lowers his cooldowns when it hits.

W.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block.
W.notes: Essence Flux: a missile that marks; detonated by his attacks or abilities.

E.notes: Arcane Shift: a blink, then fires a bolt at the nearest enemy.

R.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block.
R.notes: Trueshot Barrage: a long global missile.

profile.windowAgainst: Ezreal's window is when Arcane Shift is on cooldown: he cannot escape an all-in.
